issue.title: bug with attrs converters
issue.body:
@euresti I'm getting new errors when running mypy against the attrs doctests:

```
Line 1, in converters1
Failed example:
    import attr
    @attr.s
    class C(object):
        x = attr.ib(converter=int)
    o = C("1")
    o.x
Expected nothing
Got:
    main:4: error: Unsupported converter function, only named functions are currently supported
```

I assume this is trying to ward off lambdas, but getting tripped up by builtins?

Btw, Is there an existing issue for creating a mypy plugin search path, so that we can move the attrs plugin into the attrs project?

body:
Note that adding at least a single annotation to `foo` fixed this. It looks like this should be easy to fix.

cc @euresti
Having the same issue with lambdas.
How is possible to skip this warning? It appears even in typed functions and it annoys me.
Someone (you?) will have to update the plugin.

issue.title: False Positive: Unsupported converter, only named functions and types are currently supported
issue.body:
* Are you reporting a bug, or opening a feature request?
a bug (maybe duplicate of #6172 but I am not sure)
* Please insert below the code you are checking with mypy,
  or a mock-up repro if the source is private. We would appreciate
  if you try to simplify your case to a minimal repro.
```
cat > test_mypy.py << EOL
import attr

def test_convert(val):
    return int(val)

@attr.s
class Test:
    a: int = attr.ib(converter=test_convert)

t = Test(a="1")
print(t)
EOL
mypy test_mypy.py
```
* What is the actual behavior/output?
```
test.py:8: error: Unsupported converter, only named functions and types are currently supported
```
* What is the behavior/output you expect?
As I an using a named function, this output seems incorrect
* What are the versions of mypy and Python you are using?
```
Python 3.7.2
attrs==19.1.0
mypy==0.670
mypy-extensions==0.4.1
```
  Do you see the same issue after installing mypy from Git master?
yes happened with `mypy==0.680+dev.892b8d85afb80c9833248f2a8acf1c65023e0cad` as well.
* What are the mypy flags you are using? (For example --strict-optional)
None
* If mypy crashed with a traceback, please paste
  the full traceback below.

(You can freely edit this text, please remove all the lines
you believe are unnecessary.)

body: @ilevkivskyi can you demonstrate how I Can add an annotation to suppress this error?
Seems like similar issue exists with flake8 which does not go away with type annotations... Any idea how I can work around that one other than suppress it?
@officialcryptomaster this sounds like you should report the issue to flake8, unless I'm misunderstanding what you say.
This is also happening with annotated functions that use [`functools.singledispatch()`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functools.html#functools.singledispatch).
Maybe the warning should read "Unsupported converter, only types and named functions with an annotated return type are currently supported" 🙂
